name: pinpal-projects
description: Simple projects. You and ChatGPT on the same tickets.

interface.shortDescription: Simple projects for you and AI
interface.longDescription:
Pinpal Projects is a simple project app. Projects hold numbered tickets, each with a status and a thread, plus a Markdown body, labels, a star and files. No workflows, no sprints, no required fields, no seats. It works for code and for everyday projects, and the apps run on iPhone, iPad and Mac.

You and ChatGPT work on the same tickets. You write a ticket, with a screenshot if you like, from your iPhone, iPad or Mac; ChatGPT picks it up, works on it and writes what changed in the thread. Or ChatGPT finds a problem while it works and files it, and you review and comment.

Connected to ChatGPT, a project becomes a place where both of you file and report. ChatGPT can list and read tickets, file new ones, comment in the thread, set a status (new, in progress, blocked, done, deployed, or the project's own), assign existing labels, star a ticket, attach a log or a screenshot, and read the files a person attached. Every status change is written into the thread with its note, so the trail is complete.

At connect you pick one project, or all of them. A connection can be revoked at any time in the project's settings, and you see in the app what was filed and by whom.
